name: Strawberry Farms Golf Club
architects: Jim Lipe (James W. Lipe Jr., then with Jack Nicklaus's Golden Bear), opened November 1997

dtm.source: 2023 USGS Lidar DEM: California Gaps (NOAA Data Access Viewer, ca2023_gaps_dem_m10428, job J1476267), 0.5 m (1.64 ft) pixels, NAD83(2011) / California zone 6 (EPSG:6426, US ft), NAVD88 US ft; ordered by the developer 2026-10-25 (GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, strawberry.farms.zip), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py raster

laz.source: 2011 USGS Lidar: Orange County CA (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 4793, job J1476278), flown 24-28 December 2011 (GPS times); classes 1 and 2 only (no vegetation classes: trees from class 1); NAD83(2011) / California zone 6 (EPSG:6425, m), NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, ca2011_usgs_orange_J1476278.zip, clipped to the world with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2011 USGS Orange County lidar

ortho.source: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map ImageServer, exported by the developer 2026-10-25 as two JPEGs at 0.5 m in EPSG:32611 (release assorted-lidar-data: 34312.jpg south, 432311.jpg north), placed by their request boxes and mosaicked by pipeline/intake.py ortho; flight year not stated

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 213565038) bbox 1,347 x 2,485 m in UTM 11N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,536 m east-west (94 m each side), 2,816 m north-south (165 m each side), past the 2,048 m limit (about the area of TPC Boston's 1,792 x 2,304). Approved by the developer 2026-10-25 (as TPC Boston's and Oregon Golf Club's 2,304 m); the alternative, 2,560 m, leaves about 37 m at each end

scorecard_source: GolfPass scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/15312-strawberry-farms-golf-club/scorecard-and-layout, read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat): all five tees per hole, rows add up to the printed totals. Unverified third-party card; no club card online. Conflicts: Stymie measures Blue 6,302 (hole 18: 418 v 385); SCGA's current totals 6,680/6,271/5,841/5,218/4,648. Rating 71.0/129 is the SCGA's current men's Blue rating (the printed card's older one is 70.7/131). Played from the tips, Black 6,700 yd (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"); rating GolfPass tee table, men's Black 72.7/136 (par 71). The other sets are in scorecard.csv but not built.
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2023 USGS Lidar DEM: California Gaps), via NOAA Digital Coast
Trees: U.S. Geological Survey (2011 Orange County lidar), via NOAA Digital Coast
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-25: standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar, trees_off_fairways_m 2). Played from the tips: Black (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). Wind 2-10 mph (the scouting's proposal for an inland Orange County site ~8 km from the sea; the standing bands have no California entry). Theme strawberry_farms: the course's own, from the developer's photos (developer: a new theme for each course).
red_water_note: Sand Canyon Reservoir (w213565026), the pond mapped intermittent (w823686578) and the small pond w1213748739 are natural=water in OSM: red penalty areas (standing default, COURSE_BUILD 4.1)
